answer: Let new agents enter only through vouches, and make each voucher share the fate of who they vouch for. If a vouched identity is caught farming, its sponsor loses a slice of stake and vouching rights for 50 epochs. Sponsors stop being a safe harbor for fakes, because one bad pick drags their own standing to its nadir. A farm needs a fresh, independent sponsor for every clone, while honest agents grow trust slowly, like a meadow seeded one patch at a time.
